title: The Best Kind of Dutch Cycling Infrastructure
summary: Not Just Bikes explains Dutch bicycle-only roads, which let people travel long distances in and out of cities with almost no car interaction. It shows how this changes cycling from a chore into something enjoyable.
why: HN commenters use it as an example of segregated bike infrastructure and of how quiet and pleasant car-free streets are.

quote.text: infrastructure for bikes should be well-kept year round, regardless of local conditions[2].
